result:
**I'd give every human a built-in, non-negotiable sense of awe.**

Not forced positivity. Not mandatory kindness. Just the permanent, visceral understanding that we are tiny, brief sparks on a rock hurtling through a universe that is almost entirely hostile to life… and that this is *incredibly* cool.

If people actually *felt* the scale of it, most of the stupid shit we do to each other would become embarrassing. Tribalism, status games, ideological possession, environmental vandalism; they all start looking like toddlers fighting over crayons while standing in the Notre-Dame cathedral while it's on fire.

The cruelty, the denial, the boredom, the waste; a huge amount of it is only possible because people have successfully numbed themselves to how astonishing it is to be conscious at all. Strip away that numbness and you don't need to legislate morality. The perspective does most of the work.

Everything else (better technology, better systems, better art) would follow naturally from a species that stopped sleepwalking through the miracle.

That's the one change.
